bug_semantics: Unauthenticated GraphQL IDOR in QuoteGraphQl estimateTotals: Magento\QuoteGraphQl\Model\Resolver\EstimateTotals::resolve maps a caller-supplied masked cart_id through MaskedQuoteIdToQuoteId and returns the full Cart model (email, addresses, items, totals) without QuoteGraphQl GetCartForUser ownership/store checks. A network attacker who already knows a logged-in customer's 32-character masked quote id (AC:H; Adobe: conditions beyond attacker control) can invoke the anonymous estimateTotals mutation, load that customer's quote, and read high-sensitivity cart/PII. Integrity is not the scored impact (I:N); the mutation also runs TotalsInformationManagement::calculate, but the CWE-863 bypass is the missing cart-owner authorization before the Cart is returned.
flaw_origin: LYNX-312 (2024-02-07) first added the estimateTotals mutation as a storefront totals estimator. The new resolver cloned the EstimateShippingMethods cart_id→quote lookup and skipped the GetCartForUser helper that other QuoteGraphQl cart mutations (cart, setShippingAddressesOnCart, addSimpleProductsToCart, …) already used to refuse guest access to customer carts. That first-write is the BIC; later PHP 8.4 / totals-builder refactors preserved the missing check until AC-14951 / APSB25-94 inserted GetCartForUser.

Patched Magento Open Source tags that actually contain the mechanism: 2.4.9-alpha3, 2.4.8-p3, 2.4.7-p8. The only unauthenticated authorization-read code change shared by 2.4.7-p7→p8, 2.4.8-p2→p3, and 2.4.9-alpha2→alpha3 is app/code/Magento/QuoteGraphQl/Model/Resolver/EstimateTotals.php adding GetCartForUser::execute($maskedCartId, $context->getUserId(), $storeId) before calculate()/Cart return. 2.4.6-p12/p13 have no EstimateTotals.php (feature did not exist); Adobe's bulletin copies one version matrix across all APSB25-94 CVEs.

Vulnerable sink at introducer 3d6bdb94951cfad00297e2c3ab5eeff15d5ad528 EstimateTotals.php resolve() L58-L87: $cartId=$this->maskedQuoteIdToQuoteId->execute($args['input']['cart_id']); then totalsInformationManagement->calculate($cartId, …); return ['cart'=>['model'=>$this->cartRepository->get($cartId)]]. Schema EstimateTotalsOutput.cart: Cart exposes customer cart fields. Same sink on 2.4.8-p2 L50-L80 without GetCartForUser.

GetCartForUser::execute (QuoteGraphQl/Model/Cart/GetCartForUser.php) is the standard cart ACL: after mask→quote load it denies when cart customerId != current user, while allowing guest-on-guest. APSB25-94 inserts that call; sibling estimateShippingMethods still used mask-only lookup on 2.4.8-p2 and was not patched in p3 (later community PR 41021), confirming the scored C:H read is the estimateTotals Cart return, not shipping-method listing.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: APSB25-94 CVE-2025-54265 is CWE-863 incorrect authorization, unauthenticated (PR:N), high complexity, confidentiality-only. NVD/CVE.org remain Analyzed; the GHSA is not withdrawn. Diffing the patched Open Source tags against their pre-patch counterparts shows a single storefront authorization-read change that matches that profile: QuoteGraphQl estimateTotals loaded any quote from a masked cart_id and returned the Cart GraphQL type, omitting GetCartForUser. That is a classic Magento GraphQL customer-cart IDOR (guest caller + leaked customer cart hash). Admin ACL/LoginAsCustomer/SaveRole edits in the same security drop require admin privileges (CVE-2025-54263/54267) and ServiceInputProcessor tightening is the CVE-2025-54236 follow-up, not this CVE. BIC search started from the vulnerable lines, not from AI-marked commits: git log --follow / -S and parent-tree ls-tree show LYNX-312 3d6bdb94951cfad00297e2c3ab5eeff15d5ad528 as the first write of EstimateTotals::resolve (L58-L87) with the mask-only lookup; parent 86b187fa… has no such class. The commit is a GitHub-UI single-parent landing; no finer public member commits were reconstructable. It precedes affected 2.4.7-beta3+ / 2.4.8 / 2.4.9-alpha2 and is absent from 2.4.6, which never shipped this mutation (bulletin-wide version table). The first content fix is AC-14951 bf1f471de6c0d708c97e5563907c14f9c51f6365, which lands in 2.4.9-alpha3; 2.4.8-p3 and 2.4.7-p8 squash-backport the same GetCartForUser call.
